outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial transcriptomic heatmap overlays on tissue sections, not a summary bar/mean plot; individual data points are not applicable to this visualization type.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot where each dot represents an individual patient's TMPRSS11B expression value, with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual data points are directly shown.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual replicate values overlaid as dots for each of the four groups.
